question: What are the trunks made of?
html:
Our trunks are made with fabric from recycled plastic bottles, about 11 bottles per trunk (Fair Harbor public filings). The exact fabric blend, liner material and certifications are not in the data we hold, so we won't guess at them.

What we know

  • Recycled bottles. Each trunk uses roughly 11 recycled plastic bottles (Fair Harbor public filings).
  • Scale of the program. The brand reports about 26M bottles used to date (Fair Harbor public filings). The date of that tally is not given.
  • Implied sales. At 11 bottles per trunk, that tally fits roughly $60-80M of cumulative sales through 2021 (est., low confidence) (Fair Harbor public filings).
  • Brand position. Recycled materials anchor the move from a swim brand to a year-round sustainable lifestyle brand (Fair Harbor growth plan).

What the data does not cover

  • Fabric composition by percentage, such as the polyester and spandex split.
  • Liner construction and materials.
  • Third-party recycled-content certification.
  • Whether newer lines (golf, kids, collegiate, B2B custom) use the same recycled fabric. These launched in 2025-2026 (Fair Harbor growth plan).

Product tech packs, supplier fabric certificates and the live product spec pages would answer these. That data is not in our current set.

Why fabric detail matters

  • Swim is the most-returned category at Shopify brands, at 21.6% (Fair Harbor growth plan).
  • Clear material and fit information can reduce "not as expected" returns. That effect on Fair Harbor is an estimate, not a measured result.

The recycled-bottle story is the clearest proof behind the sustainable lifestyle positioning in the growth plan, and accurate fabric detail on every product page is a cheap lever against swim returns while margin is the main problem.

Next actions

  1. Pull tech packs and supplier certificates for the top 20 trunk styles. Publish fabric composition and recycled content on each product page.
  2. Confirm whether the non-swim lines use recycled fabric. Non-swim is now 64.0% of 372 live products (Fair Harbor growth plan).
  3. Date-stamp the 26M bottle figure and set a refresh cadence before using it in wholesale rep materials.
  4. Tag returns by reason code for swim. This would show whether fabric or fit drives the return rate.
